[i]How to Install: [/i][list=1]
[*][size=2]Go to your Stardew Valley installation folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Back up your Stardew Valley\Contents\Characters\Harvey.xnb and Stadew Valley\Contents\Portraits\Harvey.xnb [/size]
[*][size=2]Extract the contents of the .zip file into the Stardew Valley\Contents folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Allow the files to overwrite.[/size]
[/list]
[i]NO OVERWRITE Install: [/i](Requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url], [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/entoarox-framework.4228/]Entoarox Framework[/url], and [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/xnb-loader.4506/]Xnb Loader[/url])[list=1]
[*][size=2]Go to your Stardew Valley installation folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract the contents of the .zip file into the Stardew Valley\Mods\XnbLoader\ModContent folder.[/size]
[/list]
Harvey is probably my favorite of the bachelors, partly because of his personality and partly because he's the only one who is legitimately "older" [s](barring Shane)[/s] having been through medical school. This is a more personal edit to fit my own view of Harvey. [size=1](Late 20's or early 30's, stress of med school plus the rigors of work have brought silver to his temples prematurely, and that coupled with good humor have begun leaving lines around his eyes and mouth.) [/size][size=2]Perhaps someone else will enjoy it as much as I do, so here we are.[/size]

A big thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/ConcernedApe]ConcernedApe[/url] for his wonderful game I've spent many hundreds of hours playing and countless more modifying. And an extra kudos for his original Harvey Portrait and Sprite which was used as the basis for my own modified file.
